vectors.name: get_device_info_pa1
vectors.description: ArtRdm to Port-Address 1 carrying RDM GET DEVICE_INFO (0x0060) to 7FF0:00000001; RdmPacket without start code 0xCC
vectors.source: Art-Net 4 rev 1.4dp (23/10/2025), ArtRdm packet definition p.92-93; RDM bytes per ANSI E1.20
vectors.notes: RdmPacket starts with sub-start-code 0x01. Message Length (24) and the checksum still count the omitted 0xCC start code, exactly as on the wire.
